description: Cenotaph: standalone Morphe patches for Instagram. Chat wallpaper, chat tint, colour map, bubble corners, local font, DM streaks, theme picker, settings app and a Piko settings row. Every patch registers itself with the runtime, and both settings screens render one shared schema. Built for Instagram 447.0.0.55.81 (385311895).

patches.name: Cenotaph - Bubble corners
patches.description: Sets the corner radius of rounded chat surfaces from Cenotaph Settings (0 = square).

patches.name: Cenotaph - Category in Piko Settings
patches.description: Adds a Cenotaph category screen to Piko Settings (wallpaper, tint, bubbles, font, privacy). No-op unless Piko is fused alongside.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Chat wallpaper
patches.description: Background image behind DM threads, plus chat tint and hiding the Seen-by line. Configure in Cenotaph Settings.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Colour map
patches.description: Remaps UI colours to a local palette from hex pairs in Cenotaph Settings. Local only.

patches.name: Cenotaph - DM streaks
patches.description: Fire badge per conversation, on the thread header, plus a summary next to Messages. Counted locally.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Local chat font
patches.description: Applies a local .ttf/.otf to chat text from Cenotaph Settings. Local only.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Runtime (required)
patches.description: Lifecycle hook into Instagram's Application. Every other Cenotaph patch registers here; leave it enabled.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Settings app
patches.description: Adds the Cenotaph Settings launcher icon: wallpaper, colour map, bubbles, font, streaks.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Theme picker
patches.description: + button on the chat theme preview: pick a wallpaper override for that thread (local only).

release_notes:
- Settings row reads "Gallery picker, reset"
- Design notes removed
- README rewritten as a single page

Verified on the 439 APKM: 9/9 patches applied, every feature registration call present, settings activity in the manifest.
